# `nlink-lab metrics`

For an interactive view of the same data, see [`top`](top.md).

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Stream live metrics from a lab via Zenoh (no root required)

Usage: nlink-lab metrics [OPTIONS]

Options:
  -L, --lab <LAB>
          The lab. Default: `$NLINK_LAB`, then the one `nlink-lab use` selected, then the only running lab

      --node <NODE>
          Filter to specific node

  -c, --count <COUNT>
          Number of samples then exit

      --zenoh-connect <ZENOH_CONNECT>
          Zenoh connect endpoint

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
